$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM. Fetched at runtime by the /proof page. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 event log on 2026-09-02 and cross-checked against the Phala control-plane API; both report a7777da3. Image digests are the linux/amd64 children of the cosign-signed proof-v27 index for sub2api (INDEX 575f5f0c) built by publish-tee-images run 33585990032 from commit 6e467d29f; the attestor image is deliberately left at its proof-v20 pin (INDEX cef1d03d) because deploy/attestor was not touched, and repinning it would widen the attested surface for nothing. VERIFICATION SCOPE, stated plainly: composeHash, osImageHash, the image digests and the build commit were each read back from a live source, and composeHash was cross-checked against two independent ones. The cosign keyless signature was NOT verified locally for this release - the workflow performs the signing and its run succeeded, and anyone can verify certificate identity https://github.com/FiiLabs/sub2api/.github/workflows/publish-tee-images.yml@refs/heads/feat/two-sided-market plus the embedded githubWorkflowSha against the sourceCommit below, but this file does not claim it was done. This release changes the footer only: no backend code, no migrations. It adds the project's X account and rebuilds the contact block. The links previously sat at opposite ends of a full-width row, which on a wide screen reads as two unrelated blocks - a visitor has to scan across to discover that the right-hand one exists at all. They are several entrances to the same thing, so they now sit together in one centred rail: the support address, a divider, then the social buttons. The icon paths were changed from 44 by 44 artwork with the circular background baked in, to plain 24 by 24 glyphs, because the buttons now draw their own rounded background and the old paths would have produced a circle inside a circle with no way to style hover on the glyph alone. Both footers had to move to the new viewBox together; missing one would shrink its icons into a dot in the corner without raising an error. The Stay Connected label became screen-reader-only rather than being deleted, since the icons are self-evident visually but the group still needs a name. A test file was added for the footer, which previously had none: it pins the two account URLs as literals, because a wrong handle turns no test red and simply sends visitors to someone else's page, and it pins that the address and every social entry share one DOM container, so that the old split layout cannot quietly return. Earlier in this line: proof-v26 (upstream sync through v0.1.185 and beyond, Claude Fable 5.1), v24 (public pricing copy aligned to 14 percent and a 50 percent revenue share), v23, v22, v21, v20, v19, v18, v17, v16/v15. osImageHash, appId and instanceId are unchanged; the deploy passed --no-dev-os explicitly, because phala deploy silently switches to a dev OS image when it detects a local SSH key and a dev OS would void the attestation, and the control plane confirms is_dev false after the rollout. A full postgres backup was taken and verified beforehand - downloaded from S3, gzip-tested, 110 COPY sections, two more than the previous release because the v0.1.185 migrations added the plugin tables. Frontend suite: 273 files and 1997 cases, type check and lint clean. This rollout completed in 84 seconds with no incident.
